pages.text: International driver’s license for U.S. citizens | USAGov Skip to main content International driver’s license for U.S. citizens Are you a U.S. citizen planning to drive while traveling abroad? Find out if you need an International Driving Permit (IDP) for the country you are visiting. Know what an International Driving Permit (IDP) is and if you need one An International Driving Permit (IDP), sometimes known as an international driver's license, allows you to drive legally in another country. An IDP translates your identifying information into different languages. U.S. citizens visiting Canada and Mexico don't need an IDP to drive. But U.S. citizens visiting many countries must have an IDP. Use the Department of State's website to search for the country you will be visiting . On that country’s page, see the transportation for the destination’s driver’s license rules. How to get and use an International Driving Permit There are two official organizations authorized by the U.S. Department of State to issue IDPs: American Automobile Association (AAA). Learn how to apply for an IDP online, in person, or by mail through AAA. American Automobile Touring Alliance (AATA). Complete the AATA application online with a passport photo and U.S. driver's license. While visiting another country, carry both your IDP and driver’s license. An IDP is valid for one year and cannot be renewed. Beware of other websites that claim to issue international driver’s licenses or IDPs. Many are fraudulent and may try to scam you out of money or personal information. LAST UPDATED: April 14, 2026 SHARE TH

International Health Regulations Mar. 20, 2026 At a glance International Health Regulations (IHR) provide an overarching legal framework that defines countries mutual obligations in managing public health risks, events, and emergencies that have the potential to cross borders. CDC works with countries around the globe to comply with the IHR by building local capacity to prevent, detect, and respond to health emergencies. Overview The IHR 2005 represents an agreement between 196 countries that have committed to developing and maintaining specific public health capacities that enable them to prevent, detect and respond to public health threats within their borders. Furthermore, when an outbreak or other significant public health event occurs, these countries will report this event under the IHR for the awareness of all countries that are party to the agreement. These outbreaks, or significant events, are considered events of international public health importance. CDC works with countries around the globe to comply with the IHR 2005. pages.text: International travel documents for children | USAGov Skip to main content International travel documents for children See what documents a child needs to travel to or from the U.S. alone, with a parent, or a guardian. Learn about passports for minors, consent letters, and other requirements to travel. Providing parental consent when a child travels without custodial parents Ports of entry in many countries have security measures to prevent international child abduction . If your child is traveling alone or with only one parent or legal guardian, they may need a letter of consent. It is preferred that the letter of consent is in English and notarized. If the child is traveling with one custodial parent, the letter should be from the other parent. If the child is traveling with a guardian or alone, both parents should sign the letter. The letter should say: "I acknowledge that my child is traveling outside the country with [the name of the adult] with my permission." Contact the embassy or consulate of the country your child will be visiting and ask about letters of consent and other entry and exit requirements for that country. U.S. citizen children traveling outside the U.S. Children traveling to most other countries are required to have a U.S. passport. Learn how to get a passport for a minor under 18. pages.description: The crustaceans, non-native and fierce, are taking over the Gulf of Maine. Could eating them help draw down the population?
pages.text: Invasive green crabs: If you can't beat them, eat them. | National Geographic By Kea Krause Photographs by Brian Skerry Published July 11, 2022 • 12 min read West Bath, Maine — If you close your eyes, a green crab scuttling up your forearm feels more spider than sea creature, its little legs picking their way as if spinning silk. If you open your eyes, you will see the forged work of 200 million years: bumpy carapace, plated apron, calcified pincers. The small crabs are exquisite, seemingly carved from jade. The big ones are monstrous looking. They are nimble and chaotic, and likely under any beach rock in the Gulf of Maine. But here, the European green crab is not native. It is an invader , a species that traveled to the region in the 1800s in the ballast water of trading ships. In the centuries since, the crabs have established a thriving population, feasting on soft-shell clams and blue mussels, overtaking fisheries that have sustained Mainers for centuries. Their monstrous appetites and canny ability to adapt and reproduce have outcompeted any efforts to remove them. Green crabs ( Carcinus maenas ) are an invasive species that first appeared in New England waters in the 1800s, mostly likely arriving in the onboard water of large oceangoing vessels. The species’ population has exploded in recent years due to warming seawater temperatures in the Gulf of Maine. Now, one of the last defenses against these marauding creatures is not to eradicate them, but to eat them . SBICs invest in small businesses in the form of debt and equity. The SBA doesn’t invest directly into small businesses, but it does provide funding to qualified SBICs with expertise in certain sectors or industries. Those SBICs then use their private funds, along with SBA-guaranteed funding, to invest in small businesses. What you can get SBICs invest in small businesses through debt, equity, or a combination of both. Debt is a loan an SBIC gives to a business, which the business must pay back, along with any interest. Equity is a share of ownership an SBIC gets in a business in exchange for providing funding. pages.text: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack 3 days ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Ella Kipling Reuters Iran and the US are vying for control of the Strait of Hormuz Iran launched a drone attack against a US military base in Bahrain on Sunday, its second attempt to target the country in three days. The country's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it targeted the US air defence radar facility at al-Riffa air base in Bahrain using six drones. Bahrain's military said its air defence systems intercepted and destroyed the Iranian air attacks "before they could achieve their objectives". It comes after Iran fired drones at Bahrain on Friday, its first attack against Gulf countries since September. The US and Iran are locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz. About a fifth of the world's gas and oil supply usually flows through it but shipping has been restricted since the outbreak of war in February. Iran insists that it should control the strait and has been attacking what it calls "unauthorised" traffic, while the US military is providing protection for tankers shuttling oil through the strait to keep exports flowing from Gulf Arab states. Daithi O'Corrain, 48, is accused of doing extensive research before he allegedly used chemicals and various tools - including an axe - to damage a US Air National Guard C-130 Hercules parked at Shannon Airport near Limerick. American prosecutors have charged him with destruction of government property, which carries a maximum sentence of 10 years in prison. O'Corrain is not currently in US custody, according to the Associated Press news agency, and it is unclear whether he has a lawyer who could speak on his behalf. In filings unsealed by prosecutors in New York on Tuesday, agents from the FBI argued that the act jeopardised US national security. They say the plane was parked at the airport while en route to another country on a US military assignment. pages.text: IRS Freedom of Information Act | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content IRS Freedom of Information Act More In Our Agency IRS organization Financial and budget reports Tax statistics Do business with the IRS Criminal Investigation Whistleblower Office Volunteer Freedom of Information Act Privacy policy Civil rights Enacted in 1966, the Freedom of Information Act, or FOIA, gives any person the right to access federal agency records or information. The FOIA is based on the presumption that the government and its information belong to the people. A 1996 amendment to the FOIA, required federal agencies to make many types of records available online. Visit the IRS FOIA Library to learn more. New law, like the Open Government Act , as well as new policies, such as those issued by the President and the Attorney General, promote the spirit of transparency envisioned by our founding fathers. pages.text: IRS 세무 자원봉사자 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content IRS 세무 자원봉사자 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 저희 기관 IRS조직 (영어) 재무 및 예산 보고서 (영어) 세금 통계 (영어) IRS와의 사업 진행 (영어) 범죄 조사 (영어) 내부 고발자 부서 (영어) 자원봉사자 정보자유법 (영어) 개인 정보 보호 정책 (영어) 시민 평등권 세금 신고하는 방법을 배우고 동시에 귀하의 지역사회를 변화시키십시오. 어떻게 변화를 이룰까요? 간단합니다. 자원봉사 소득세 지원( VITA ) 혹은 고령자 세무 상담( TCE ) 프로그램을 통해 세금 신고 무료 봉사를 통해 지역사회를 도울 수 있습니다. 귀하는 세금 신고 도움을 필요로 하는 저소득 및 중위 소득 계층을 위한 무료 세금 지원을 제공하기 위한 교육을 받게 될 것입니다. 그리고 귀하는 자원봉사자로서 매년 전국 수천 곳의 사무소에서 수백만 명의 세금 신고를 돕고 있는 수천 명과 함께하게 될 것입니다. 본기관과 협력하여 해당 지역의 무료 세금 신고 사이트를 후원하거나 주최하는 데 관심이 있는 경우 VITA / TCE 자원봉사자 및 파트너 등록(영어) 양식을 작성하여 제출하면, 귀하의 문의에 대한 후속 조치를 취해 드리겠습니다. 헌신적인 세금 봉사자로서, 스폰서 단체와 함께 일하도록 배정됩니다. 먼저 교육을 받은 후, 해당 지역사회의 사무소에서 자원봉사를 시작합니다. 훈교육은 온라인과 오프라인 수업으로 제공됩니다. 세금 사무소는 일반적으로 저녁과 주말에 영업하며 운영 시간은 유연합니다. 가까운 곳에서 자원봉사 사무소를 찾을 수 있을 것입니다. 관심있습니까? 이제 VITA / TCE 자원 봉사자 및 파트너 등록(영어) 양식을 사용해 더 자세한 내용과 다음 단계에 대한 정보에 대해 문의하여 귀하의 지역사회에 환원하는 VITA 또는 TCE 세무 자원봉사자가 되는것에 한걸음 더 가까워 질 수 있습니다. 자원봉사자는 무슨 일을 합니까? 자원 봉사자의 역할을 선택하십시오(영어) 왜 사람들이 자원봉사를 합니까? IRS는 ID.me 계정을 사용해 사용자의 신원을 확인하며 개인정보를 보호하고 데이터를 안전하게 유지합니다. 해당 계정을 생성하려면 만 18세 이상이어야 합니다. 이미 계정이 있습니까? 로그인하려면 IRS 계정 또는 서비스 를 선택하십시오. 본 페이지에 포함된 주제 ID.me 안내 ID.me 계정 생성 방법 IRS 계정 및 서비스 정보 보호 방법 자주 발생하는 문제 해결하기 ID.me 안내 ID.me는 정부 기관 및 기업과 협력하는 신뢰할 수 있는 기술 파트너로, 로그인 시 사용자의 신원을 확인할 수 있는 안전한 디지털 신원 인증 서비스를 제공합니다. ID.me는 또한 최신 연방 보안 기준을 충족합니다. 정부용 ID.me (영어) IRS와 ID.me ID.me 계정 생성 방법 계정 생성은 2단계 과정입니다. 먼저 계정을 생성한 후, 신원 확인 과정은 한 번만 완료하면 됩니다. 계정 설정에 필요한 사항: 개인 이메일 주소 최소 8자 이상의 고유한 비밀번호 인증 앱, 얼굴 또는 지문 인식, 문자 메시지가 가능한 휴대전화 등 다중요소 인증 보호 ID.me 계정 생성 도움말(영어) 신원 확인에 필요한 사항: 사회보장번호(SSN) 또는 개인납세자식별번호(ITIN) 다음과 같은 사진이 부착된 유효한 정부 발급 신분증: 운전면허증 또는 주 신분증 여권 또는 여권 카드 ID.me 신원 확인 서류 안내(영어) 계정 생성 단계: 필요한 IRS 계정 또는 서비스를 선택합니다. 계정 생성 또는 로그인하기 를 선택합니다. 안내에 따라 ID.me 계정을 생성합니다. 안내에 따라 ID.me를 통해 신원을 확인합니다. No, it's a 'miraculous' new prehistoric reptile Mirasaura grauvogeli had a featherlike crest and a tail like a monkey. “It's been a long time since I've been so blown away by a new fossil discovery.” By Asher Elbein Published July 23, 2025 Some 247 million years ago, a bizarre, six-inch-long reptile crept down a branch, its prehensile tail and feet clutching the bark like a monkey, and its narrow, birdlike face scanning its surroundings. On its back, an overlapping fan of stiff structures likely caught the light, vibrant with color. They looked very much like feathers, but were something entirely different as the reptile wasn’t related to birds or dinosaurs, and it existed a hundred million years before the first dinosaur took wing . Dubious claims are out there of leaky gut causing diseases from depression to autoimmune disorders. Experts weighed in on why that may not be the case. A scanning electron microscopel view of intestinal cells (purple), which are covered with microvilli (pink). These cells are normally packed tightly together, while nutrients are filtered and absorbed through their microvilli. In the case of leaky gut syndrome, inflammation increases the permeability of this membrane, allowing unwanted substances to pass from the digestive tract into the bloodstream. Isotope R&D and Production (DOE IRP) The DOE Isotope Program (DOE IRP), and its predecessor organizations, has been at the forefront of the development and production of radioactive and stable isotopes that are used worldwide. The Program supplies isotopes and related services to the Nation under the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 and has the sole authority within DOE to produce isotopes for sale and distribution. The DOE IRP produces critical radioactive and stable isotopes in short supply for the nation or that no domestic entity has the infrastructure or core competency to produce. The Program is typically the only, or one of few, global producers for these novel isotopes. Isotopes are high-priority commodities of strategic importance for the nation and are essential in medical diagnosis and treatment, discovery science, national security, industrial processes and manufacturing, space exploration and communications, biology, archeology, quantum science and other fields. pages.description: Officials are unsure why the satellite fractured unexpectedly, splintering into nearly 200 pieces
pages.text: ISS Astronauts Forced to Briefly Take Shelter as Russian Satellite Suddenly Breaks Up in Orbit Skip to main content An illustration of debris and satellites in the geostationary ring around Earth. ESA / ID&Sense / ONiRiXEL under CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO A decommissioned Russian satellite in low-Earth orbit unexpectedly splintered into more than 100 pieces on Wednesday, temporarily sending International Space Station (ISS) astronauts into precautionary shelters. The satellite, called Resurs-P1, was roughly 220 miles above Earth’s surface when it broke up. While “no immediate threats” were detected, according to a statement from U.S. Space Command, the nine-person crew aboard the ISS—which orbits roughly 250 miles above Earth—briefly sheltered within three docked spacecraft out of an abundance of caution. Two astronauts went into the Boeing Starliner, which is experiencing an extended stay at the station , while the others went into SpaceX’s Crew Dragon and the Russian Soyuz capsules. After about an hour, all were cleared to resume normal operations—which likely involved getting back to bed, as the incident occurred during the astronauts’ typical sleep period . It is currently unclear why the satellite suddenly fragmented. The event, detected by LeoLabs , a U.S.-based space-tracking firm, has so far gone unacknowledged by the Russian space agency, Roscosmos. Scientists speculated a technical malfunction caused the satellite’s explosion or that it collided with another piece of space junk. As he climbed with the friends who had brought him, he began to spot monarchs along the path. Only a few at first. But the higher he went, the more he heard a sound in the background, like something whispering in the trees. Suddenly, a swarm of butterflies was flying overhead, millions of orange and black wings fluttering against the blue sky beyond. “There were so many that you could feel a slight breeze when they flew over you,” he says. Falmouth Oyster Festival By Davey Brett Published September 2, 2026 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (UK). If you ever need an excuse to eat an oyster, Bobby Groves has plenty. The author of Oyster Isles: A Journey Through Britain and Ireland’s Oysters — a book written on a 5,000-mile motorcycle ride across the UK and Ireland charting the oyster industry and its heritage — has more than 20 years’ experience in the industry and makes a compelling argument for their consumption. “I think people want something hyper-local, something [with flavour] that reflects the environment, something that can help fight climate change and is very healthy to eat,” Bobby says. The humble oyster ticks all four boxes, each one filtering surrounding waters, developing its own unique flavour and trapping nitrogen and carbon in its shell. Two main types of oyster are consumed in the UK. The Pacific ‘rock’ oyster and the European native ‘flat’ oyster. Both are bivalve molluscs, but the two differ in origin, taste and shape. Photograph: Dado Ruvić/Reuters Meta Italy fines Meta $887m for accessing Android users’ photos and videos The fine is among the largest an Italian authority has imposed on a tech giant and Meta says it plans to appeal the decision Agence France-Presse Sat 14 Nov 2026 21.02 EST Last modified on Sun 15 Nov 2026 15.03 EST Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Italy’s data protection agency has fined Facebook parent company Meta €805m ($887m) for accessing users’ photos without their specific consent. Through the Facebook application for Android devices, Meta accessed photographs, videos and related metadata belonging to Italian users “without obtaining specific consent and without properly informing them”, the authority said in a statement. Meta said it would appeal the decision. A company spokesperson said “we strongly disagree” with the assessment by the regulators “and the disproportionate level of the fine”.
